text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Monika and her friends continue to enjoy the New Year's at Gio Gehenna.
text_block_list.orig_text: 引き続きジオ・ゲヘナで正月を満喫するモニカたち。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, there's a crowd of people over there. Are they having some kind of event?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえねえ、
あっちに人だかりができてるわよ。
なにかイベントでもやってるんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Ah, if I remember correctly, we're having a taste-testing party for Landosol's winter palates today. Wanna go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
たしか今日は
ランドソルの
冬の味覚の試食会をやっているはずだ。
行ってみるか？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Of course! All of the food in Landosol is delicious and I love it! Let's hurry and get some before it's gone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん！　
ランドソルのごはんって
どれもおいしくて大好き！
なくならないうちに早くいきましょ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Mmmm, not to repeat myself, but this Landosolian food is simply delicious. It's completely different from the food in Gio Gehenna, which is basically hot, spicy, and abundant...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー、
やっぱりおいしいわね
ランドソル飯。
熱い
辛い
デカいが基本のジオ・ゲヘナの食事とは
一味も二味も違うわ……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: That just goes to show the difference in climate between our worlds. The ingredients available vary depending on the season, and the same food tastes completely different.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やはり気候の差が大きいのだろうな。
季節によって
採れる食材も全く違うし、
同じ食べ物でも
うまさがまるで違ってくるからな。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Makes sense. I've tried a lot of different things, but I still like this-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほどね。
色々食べたけど、
アタシはやっぱりこの──

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Man
text_block_list.text: Man, this red bean bun is the best! It's sweet enough to numb your brain, hot enough to wake up your stomach, and big enough to satisfy your appetite! Irresistible!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー、
このあんまんってヤツは最高だな！
脳が痺れるほどの甘味と、
胃袋が目覚める熱さ、
そして
食べ応えのあるデカさ！　
たまんねー！

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Woman
text_block_list.text: The combination of the white dough and the dark bean paste is kind of endearing too. I could eat as many as I wanted!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに生地の白さと
あんこの黒さの組み合わせも
なんだかかわいいわよね。
いくつでも食べられちゃいそう！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: This red bean bun seems to be really popular. As I was saying, I really like this one a lot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんまん、
人気みたいね。
アタシもこれは
かなりお気に入りよ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Heh. Looks like the people of Gio Gehenna have come to appreciate the charms of red bean buns. I understand, I understand this feeling completely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ、
どうやらジオ・ゲヘナの民も
あんまんの魅力に気付いたようだな。
分かる、
分かるぞ。

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Man
text_block_list.text: For me, I especially like this one called "Koshian"
text_block_list.orig_text:
特に俺は
このこしあんってヤツが気に入ったぜ。

text_block_list.name: Staff 1
text_block_list.text: Oh, Nii-san, you understand! After all, smooth bean paste is the best for red bean buns!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
兄さん分かってるね！
やっぱあんまんは
こしあんが至高だよな！

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Woman
text_block_list.text: Hey, I can't just ignore this slander. I'm an expert in the matter, and whole is better than smooth!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと、
聞き捨てならないんだけど。
あたしはなんと言っても
つぶあんね。

text_block_list.name: Staff 2
text_block_list.text: Oh, it seems like those who know their food will understand better. Yes, the best red bean buns are the ones with the whole bean paste inside. That's what history tells us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
やはり分かる人には分かるみたいですね。
そう、
あんまんはつぶあんこそ正義。
そう歴史が物語ってるのさ。

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Man
text_block_list.text: What's that? You cur. Shut up if you don't know what's good for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだぁ？　
テメエ。
物の善し悪しが分かんねえヤツは黙ってろ。

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Woman
text_block_list.text: Hey, you shouldn't say it like that. And there's nothing wrong with what he just said. It's your tongue that's wrong.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと、
そんな言い方ないでしょ。
それに彼は何も間違ってないわ。
おかしいのはあんたの舌よ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Eh, eh? What? Why are these guys fighting?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
え？　
なに？　
なんでこいつらケンカしてんの？

text_block_list.name: Staff 1
text_block_list.text: I don't like what I just heard. I think it's a bit presumptuous to say that chunky bean paste is the best, instead of the smooth texture and beauty of smooth bean paste that has been carefully strained by hand by a craftsman.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気に入らないなぁ、
職人の手で丁寧に濾したこしあんの
あのなめらかな口当たりと美しさを差し置いて、
つぶあんが正義だなんて
調子に乗りすぎじゃねえか？

text_block_list.name: Staff 2
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about? It is self-evident that the best bean paste is made by cooking the beans without breaking their skins, and you can enjoy the original texture and sweetness of the beans.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何を言ってるんですか。
小豆の皮を破らずに炊き上げ、
小豆本来の食感と甘みを感じられるつぶあんこそ、
あんこの頂点なのは自明の理でしょう。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Oh, to think that even in Gio Gehenna we could end up in this eternal argument...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
まさかジオ・ゲヘナでも
こうなってしまうのか……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, explain what's going on already! I don't get it at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ちょっと説明しなさいよ。
全然分かんないんだけど！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Since ancient times, people have debated which is better: smooth bean paste ( koshian ) or whole bean paste ( tsubushian ) red buns.
text_block_list.orig_text:
古来より、
人々の間では
こしあんとつぶあん、
どちらが優れているか議論されてきた。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: No, it's not even merely just between smooth or chunky. There are also issues about red bean paste and cream, regional differences in food names, and food-related issues that are deeply rooted in all eras.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
つぶあんこしあんだけではない。
あんこ派とクリーム派、
食べ物の名前の地域差問題と、
食にまつわる問題というものは
いつの時代でも根深いものなのだ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Yes, sometimes it can even become a spark for a war...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
ときに
戦火の火種になりかねないほどにな……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: T-That just sounds crazy... Can't that just be something solved by saying "Both are delicious"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
く、
狂ってるわ……
そんなの
「どっちもおいしい」で
片付く話じゃない！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's beyond crazy, it's madness. But Medusa, when it comes to food, people can't keep their cool. Maybe this is the original sin imposed on all of mankind...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
狂ってる。
だがなメドゥーサ、
こと食べ物のことになると
人は冷静でいられないんだ。
これは
全人類に課せられた原罪なのかもしれん……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: You're making it a bigger deal than it actually is!
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなたいそうな問題じゃないわよ！

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Man
text_block_list.text: Hey, we're going to do some sumo to decide this, REAL sumo. I'll throw away of the ring all of you who are into chunky bean paste! Don't underestimate the fundamentalism of smooth bean paste!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
相撲とんぞ相撲。
つぶあん派のヤツら一人残らず投げ飛ばしてやらぁ！
こしあん原理主義なめんなよ！

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Woman
text_block_list.text: As if I'd run away from the challenge, you idiot! I'm gonna make all you smooth bean paste supporters cry! Chunky bean paste bros, don't give in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やってやんよコラァ。
こしあん派全員泣かしてやんよボケが！
つぶあん友の会、
日和ってんじゃねえぞ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Wow, those idiots are totally out of their minds. A prime example on why people in Gio Gehenna sometimes can be just so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ、
あのバカども完全に頭に血が上ってるわ。
これだからジオ・ゲヘナ民は……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: We absolutely cannot let that happen! There should be no fighting over delicious food, and as a person who loves sweets, I cannot overlook this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことは絶対にさせん！
おいしいもので争うなんてあってはならないし、
なにより
一人のお菓子好きとして
見過ごせるわけがない。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Besides... I'm responsible as a member of Landosol for bringing so much delicious and divisives sweetness to this festival.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに……
交流祭で多くの甘味をもたらした
ランドソルの人間としての
責任もあるからな。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: But... how are we going to stop them? I don’t think there's any word that'll get through them, so maybe I should just let my petrification do the trick?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
どうやって止めるの？
とても話が通じるとは思えないし、
もういっそのこと
全員石にしちゃう？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: We'll leave that as a last resort. Don't worry, I have a plan. That's why I'm going to ask you to do your best, my comrade.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは最終手段だ。
なに安心しろ、
策はある。
というわけで
貴公には一肌脱いでもらおう。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: We'll have you go out to battle, as Lord Shogun that is!
text_block_list.orig_text:
出陣してもらうんだ、
ショーグン様にな！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Cease your bickering, cease your bickering!
text_block_list.orig_text:
静まれー、
静まれーい！

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Man
text_block_list.text: AHHHHHHHHN? What's with these kids?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああん？　
なんだ、
このガキどもは。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Do you even know who pales himself before you? It is the Great SHOGUN of the foreign land, who led the two great conflicts in Oedo Town to a resolution!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここにおわす方をどなたと心得る！
二度にわたるオーエド町の大乱を解決に導いた、
天下の大ショーグンにあらせられるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: The Shogun will now pass judgment on the dispute between smooth and chunky bean paste! Common folk around him, listen carefully!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これより、
ショーグンが
こしあんとつぶあんの争いに審判を下す！
者ども、
心して聞くがいい！

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Woman
text_block_list.text: Oedo? Am I supposed to know where that is...? Oh, but I've seen him before! He's the guy from Landosol who calmed Lady Ho-oh down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーエド？　
なにそれ……
あ、
でもあの人見たことある！
ホウオウを鎮めてくれた
ランドソルの人じゃない！

text_block_list.name: Staff 2
text_block_list.text: Ah, I saw his statue back when I went to Oedo Town recently. No doubt about it, he's THE Lord Shogun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
オーエド町に行った時に銅像見たよ。
間違いない、
ショーグン様だ！

text_block_list.name: Staff 1
text_block_list.text: W-Well, if a great person like him were to judge us then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まあ
あんたほどの立派な方がそういうなら……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Now then, Shogun, please enjoy this red bean bun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それではショーグン、
こちらのあんまんをお召し上がりください。

text_block_list.name: Residents of Gio Gehenna
text_block_list.orig_name: ジオ・ゲヘナ住民たち

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: How was it, Shogun? Hmm, I see... Everyone, the Shogun's decision has been made. Listen carefully. Shogun, what is the verdict?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いかがでしたか
ショーグン、
ふむ、
なるほど……
皆の者、
ショーグンの沙汰が下される。
心して聞くがいい。
ショーグン、
判決は？

text_block_list.name: Staff 2
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? G-Green bean paste ( Uguisuan )? It's certainly delicious, but this is a battle between smooth and chunky RED bean paste...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい？　
う、
うぐいすあん？
たしかにおいしいけど、
これは
こしあんとつぶあんの勝負じゃ……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Fool! Lord Shogun's decision is final! From now on, only green bean paste will be permitted to be eaten at Gio Gehenna, while smooth and chunky red bean paste will be permanently banned from this foreign world for good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
愚か者！　
ショーグンの決定は絶対だ！
今後
ジオ・ゲヘナで食すのを許されるのは
うぐいすあんのみ、
ジオ・ゲヘナからこしあんとつぶあんは
永久追放とする！

text_block_list.name: Residents of Gio Gehenna
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? EEEEEEEEEHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH?!
text_block_list.orig_name: ジオ・ゲヘナ住民たち
text_block_list.orig_text:
……は？　
はああああああああああ！？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Understood! Everyone get all together and... TURN TO STONE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
了解！　
ぜーんぶまとめて、
カッチカチー！

text_block_list.name: Staff 1
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's going on...? Both the smooth and chunky red bean paste buns... everything's turned to stone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんてこった……
こしあんもつぶあんも、
全部石になっちまった……

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Man
text_block_list.text: ...This can't be happening! I don't know about this Lord Shogun or whatever, but this kind of treatment it's just... way too tyrannical!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……こんなのって、
こんなのってねえだろ！
ショーグンだがなんだか知らねえけど、
横暴すぎんぞ！

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Woman
text_block_list.text: That's right! That's right! You can't just ban something, that has to be wrong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよそうよ！　
完全排除なんて間違ってるわ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: What a strange thing to say. Until just now, it was none other than you guys who were trying to destroy the other faction out of this world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしなことを言うものだな。
先ほどまで
相手の派閥を潰そうとしていたのは
他ならぬおまえたちではないか。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: The Lord Shogun himself volunteered to take on that indecision generating unnecessary trouble, so it would be extremely rude to complain now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その手間をショーグンが自ら買って出てくれたというのに、
不満を口にするなど
失礼千万だ！

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Man
text_block_list.text: Th-That's......but...... I don't like it when outsiders do whatever they want to me in the first place! So now that it's come to this, force is what I'll use to-....
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは……
でも……
そもそも余所者に好き勝手されんのが気に入らねえ！
こうなりゃ力づくで──

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Woman
text_block_list.text: I-Idiot! Stop it already! It's because of this attitude of yours that now we can't eat it anymore!
text_block_list.orig_text:
バ、
バカ！　
やめなさいよ！
こんなことしてるから
食べられなくなったんでしょ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Oooh, Lord Shogun... What a generous heart! Did you hear that, everyone?! Enjoy the sweetness you find more appropriate to your taste! Take Lord Shogun's generous words to heart!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
ショーグン……
なんと寛大なお心！
聞いたか皆の者！　
汝、
あるがままに甘味を享受せよ！
ショーグンのありがたい言葉を胸に
食すがいい！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Here, as you can see the petrification's gone. Eat as much as you want... However, no fighting allowed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
丁度石化も解けたわよ。
好きなだけ食べなさい。
ただし、
ケンカは無しでね！

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Man
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... Um, sorry for getting all worked up earlier. CHOMP. Ahhh... to be honest the chunky red bean paste bun is delicious too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おう……
その、
さっきは悪かったな、
つい
熱くなっちまって。
ああ、
つぶあんもうまいじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Gio Gehenna's Woman
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry too... The smooth bean paste is so delicious in its own right, so fighting against it is stupid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あたしも
ごめんなさい……
こしあんもこんなにおいしいのに、
ケンカして
バカみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Staff 2
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... I've shown you a very unseemly side of myself. It was outrageous to encourage conflict at our worlds mutual exchange festival...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
非常にお見苦しいところを見せてしまいました。
交流祭で争いを助長するなんて
どうかしてましたよ……

text_block_list.name: Staff 1
text_block_list.text: No, no, I should be the one embarassed here. There's no point in fighting over the same red bean paste due to the application methods.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいや、
ホントお恥ずかしい。
同じあんこ同士、
争っても仕方ないのになぁ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Phew. Looks like everyone's calmed down. Things should be fine now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
どうやら皆
冷静になったようだな。
これでもう大丈夫だろう。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: It was a riot that was about to start, but you two managed to stop it. Impressive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんな暴動寸前だったのに、
よく止められたわね。
やるじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: It's a soldier's duty to prevent conflict before it can take place. I wanted everyone to eat with a smile on their face, so I'm glad we were able to stop it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
争いを未然に防ぐのも
軍人の役目だ。
皆に笑顔で食べてもらいたかったから、
止められてよかったぞ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: There's no need to think about who's right or what you should choose when it comes to food. Anyone can like whatever they prefer, and nobody needs to care if someone else doesn't.
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰が正しいとか
どれを選ぶべきとか
そんなものは必要ない。
好きなものは好きでいいし、
そうじゃない人がいたって
かまいはしないんだ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: What's important is reading the room and the tolerance to accept one another. Without that, the old cannot be passed down, and the new cannot be born.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大事なのは
互いを受け入れる
余裕と寛容さだ。
それがなくては
古いものは受け継がれず、
新しいものは生まれないからな。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's this candy? I've never seen it before... What? A new product made with Gio Gehenna spices and red bean paste? When did something like this even come into existence...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
なんだ
この菓子は。
見たことがないが……
なに？　
ジオ・ゲヘナのスパイスと
あんこを使った新作だと？
いつの間にそんなものが……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: A marriage of spiciness and sweetness, I take it. Let's see, let's see... UGH, this is... Quite the... unique and interesting flavor.
text_block_list.orig_text:
辛さと甘さのマリアージュか。
どれどれ……
う、
これは……
ど、
独創的な
面白い味だな。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: No I mean, no matter how you cut it, that's just ba~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
どう考えても
これはマズ──

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Don't say any more. These pastries are a proof and symbol of the unity that has been created between our two worlds. It's only natural that things wouldn't mesh well at first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ以上は言うな。
この菓子は
二つの世界が交わった
証にして象徴、
最初は上手くいかなくて当然だ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: However, if we continue to foster exchange and harmony, both our country and our sweets will become better.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでも
お互いに交流と調和を重ねていけば、
国も菓子も
より良いものになっていくはずだ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: I see, that kind of thinking makes sense. So, to celebrate the bond between Landosol and Gio Gehenna, I'll allow you to eat those snacks all by yourself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか、
そういうものなのね。
じゃあ、
ランドソルとジオ・ゲヘナの交流をお祝いして、
このお菓子あげるわ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: You know, I think you just want to force them on me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
其方、
それはただ押し付けたいだけだろうが……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Anyway, {0}. I'm surprised you were able to get on along with Monika's reckless little theater act in such a short time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもアンタ、
あんな短い時間で、
よくモニカの無茶ぶり小芝居に対応できたわね。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: That's right. Well, I believed that my comrade would be up for such a task, which is the sole reason why I was able to come up with such a plan. Truly a brilliant act.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだな。
まあ、
貴公ならやってくれるだろうと
信じていたから、
あのような策を打てたんだ。
見事だったぞ。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm. What an enviable combination you two make...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーん、
いいコンビ感出しちゃってまあ。

text_block_list.name: Staff 1
text_block_list.text: Dear visitors! The steamed bean buns are done! Please enjoy them hot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご来場のみなさーん！
あんまんが蒸かしあがりましたよー！
アツアツをご賞味くださーい。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: I mean! Let me have some seconds!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって。
アタシおかわりほしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: That's right. My comrade, let us partake in said seconds aswell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだな。
我々ももらいに行くとしよう！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Monika and her friends' efforts, the tasting event ended with great success.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしてモニカたちの活躍のおかげで、
試食会は大盛況で幕を閉じるのだった。
